contract.behavior: Make GitHub CI pipeline failures propagate through eight declared Bash workflow defaults, preserving all original bodies and gates

command:
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys, yaml

workflows = [
    '.github/workflows/c11-thread-cancellation.yml',
    '.github/workflows/legacy-host-dns.yml',
    '.github/workflows/locale-objects.yml',
    '.github/workflows/socket-address-safety.yml',
    '.github/workflows/socket-message-safety.yml',
    '.github/workflows/socket-option-contracts.yml',
    '.github/workflows/stdio-file-layout.yml',
    '.github/workflows/vectored-io-safety.yml',
]
inputs = {w: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(w).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for w in workflows}
inputs['scripts/check_pipeline_exit_status.sh'] = hashlib.sha256(
    pathlib.Path('scripts/check_pipeline_exit_status.sh').read_bytes()
).hexdigest()
syntax_blocks = 0
pipeline_cases = 0
for name in workflows:
    doc = yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path(name).read_text())
    defaults = doc.get('defaults')
    assert defaults == {'run': {'shell': 'bash'}}, (name, defaults)
    for job, body in doc.get('jobs', {}).items():
        for idx, step in enumerate(body.get('steps', [])):
            if 'run' not in step:
                continue
            syn = subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=step['run'], capture_output=True, text=True)
            assert syn.returncode == 0, (name, job, idx, syn.stderr)
            syntax_blocks += 1
    explicit = ['bash', '--noprofile', '--norc', '-e', '-o', 'pipefail']
    for tag, cmd, want in [
        ('configured-failure', explicit + ['-c', "bash -c 'printf upstream-evidence; exit 7' | tee"], 7),
        ('configured-success', explicit + ['-c', "bash -c 'printf upstream-evidence; exit 0' | tee"], 0),
        ('implicit-masking-negative', ['bash', '--noprofile', '--norc', '-e', '-c', "bash -c 'printf upstream-evidence; exit 7' | tee"], 0),
    ]:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert p.returncode == want and p.stdout == 'upstream-evidence' and not p.stderr, (name, tag, p.returncode)
        pipeline_cases += 1
p = subprocess.run(['bash', 'scripts/check_pipeline_exit_status.sh'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(p.stdout, flush=True)
sys.stderr.write(p.stderr)
assert p.returncode == 0 and re.search(r'findings\s*:\s*0\b', p.stdout)
scanned = int(re.search(r'files scanned:\s*(\d+)', p.stdout).group(1))
assert scanned > 0 and len(workflows) == 8 and syntax_blocks == 53 and pipeline_cases == 24
for name, digest in inputs.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
print('BASH_DEFAULTS_VERIFIED workflows=8 pipeline_cases=24', flush=True)
print('BASH_SYNTAX_BLOCKS', syntax_blocks, flush=True)
print('WORKFLOW_INPUTS_AND_CHECKER', len(inputs), flush=True)
expected_stdout: PASS: no pipeline exit-status traps found.
